thread:
Priya: Quick field check-in for the Optimize "advisor-lite" pilot. We need to lock the launch gates and capture edge requests from CS and SRE. Core ask: recommendations-only (batching, prefix-cache, quant suggestions) + eval-triggered alerting. No auto-apply for alpha.

Arun: +1. For alpha I suggest we focus on: route-level batching advice, prefix-KV cache candidates with reuse estimate, and conservative quant profiles (int8-safe). Alerts should be simple: surface drift and attach a small triage bundle when telemetry is allowed.

Maya: From eval side: require concordance >= 85% against SME on 5 curated prompt suites and expected quant quality delta <= 2% for any suggested profile. Alerts: sample size min 100 and attach 20 labeled examples.

Zoe: CS feedback: customers want clear opt-in toggles per tenant and a visible "why" for each rec (short rationale). Dedicated customers insist on ticketed apply flow and audit CSV exports, but exports only if telemetry_consent=true.

Luis: Ops constraints: can't change reserved pools for Dedicated without manual approval. Implement "request-apply" button that opens ops ticket. Also include a hard guard: no autoscale or auto-apply in alpha. Canary automation is stretch.

Priya: UX notes: Console card should include estimated monthly savings (USD), predicted p50 latency delta, confidence score, and a one-line rationale. API returns a compact recommendations array for programmatic ingestion.

Arun: Runtime caveats: batching should not increase p95 by more than +10% default. Also avoid batching tiny requests (tokens < 32). Prefix cache recs must include estimated cold-start cost and reuse rate.

Maya: Eval alert YAML (ops review):

alert:
  id: "optimize.eval.drift"
  metric: "quality.delta"
  window: "7d"
  threshold_pct: 2.5
  min_samples: 100
  notify: ["sre", "product", "cs"]
  attach_triage_bundle_if: "telemetry_consent"

Zoe: Pilot gating checklist proposal: 1) two pilot customers (one hosted, one dedicated) committed; 2) Console opt-in toggles + docs; 3) E2E tests across batching/cache/quant paths; 4) eval harness + baseline prompt sets; 5) privacy review for triage/export; 6) rollback plan.

Luis: Owners: Arun -> runtime heuristics + canary guards; Maya -> eval harness + thresholds; Zoe -> CS + privacy coordination; Priya -> PM + spec + docs. Target alpha in 3 weeks.

Priya: Risks: sampling mismatch between our evals and customer traffic, overconfident quant suggestions on low-traffic routes, and export/legal delays. Mitigations: conservative confidence cutoffs, require tenant shadowing for quant apply, block exports until legal OK.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: advisor-lite/alpha -> staging at 3720001285 by @ci-bot

Priya: I'll produce a short spec doc and share with pilot customers later today. If anything blocks owners call it out here. :white_check_mark:
